`notes_api/` package: `server.py` (HTTP adapter, routing, JSON in/out), `service.py` (validation, `ServiceError`), `repo.py` (SQL only). `ThreadingHTTPServer`, stdlib only.

"""SQL-only persistence for notes. Every statement is parameterized."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
)
"""


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="microseconds")


class NotesRepo:
    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
        self.db_path = db_path
        with self._tx() as conn:
            conn.execute(_SCHEMA)

    def _tx(self):
        return _Tx(self.db_path)

    def create(self, title: str, body: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        now = _now()
        with self._tx() as conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (title, body, now, now),
            )
            return self._get(conn, cur.lastrowid)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def list(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self._tx() as conn:
            rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM notes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC").fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    def get(self, note_id: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        with self._tx() as conn:
            return self._get(conn, note_id)

    def update(self, note_id: int, fields: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        with self._tx() as conn:
            if self._get(conn, note_id) is None:
                return None
            # Column names come from this fixed whitelist, never from the request.
            cols = [c for c in ("title", "body") if c in fields]
            sets = ", ".join(f"{c} = ?" for c in cols + ["updated_at"])
            conn.execute(
                f"UPDATE notes SET {sets} WHERE id = ?",
                [fields[c] for c in cols] + [_now(), note_id],
            )
            return self._get(conn, note_id)

    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> bool:
        with self._tx() as conn:
            return conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)).rowcount > 0

    @staticmethod
    def _get(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None


class _Tx:
    """Short-lived connection with commit-on-success / rollback-on-error."""

    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=10)
        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

    def __enter__(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        return self.conn

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
        with closing(self.conn):
            if exc_type is None:
                self.conn.commit()
            else:
                self.conn.rollback()

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from .repo import NotesRepo

MAX_TITLE = 120
MAX_BODY = 10_000


class ServiceError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: int, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status
        self.message = message


def _title(value: Any) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ServiceError(400, "title is required")
    if len(value) > MAX_TITLE:
        raise ServiceError(400, f"title must be at most {MAX_TITLE} characters")
    return value


def _body(value: Any) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ServiceError(400, "body must be a string")
    if len(value) > MAX_BODY:
        raise ServiceError(400, f"body must be at most {MAX_BODY} characters")
    return value


class NotesService:
    def __init__(self, repo: NotesRepo) -> None:
        self.repo = repo

    def create(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.repo.create(_title(data.get("title")), _body(data.get("body", "")))

    def list(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.repo.list()

    def get(self, note_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        note = self.repo.get(note_id)
        if note is None:
            raise ServiceError(404, "note not found")
        return note

    def update(self, note_id: int, data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        fields: dict[str, str] = {}
        if "title" in data:
            fields["title"] = _title(data["title"])
        if "body" in data:
            fields["body"] = _body(data["body"])
        if not fields:
            raise ServiceError(400, "provide title and/or body to update")
        note = self.repo.update(note_id, fields)
        if note is None:
            raise ServiceError(404, "note not found")
        return note

    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> None:
        if not self.repo.delete(note_id):
            raise ServiceError(404, "note not found")

"""HTTP adapter: routing, JSON in/out, error mapping."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from typing import Any

from .repo import NotesRepo
from .service import NotesService, ServiceError

MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 1_048_576
_NOTE_PATH = re.compile(r"^/api/notes/(\d+)$")


class NotesHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server: "NotesServer"

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:  # keep output quiet
        pass

    def _send(self, status: int, payload: Any = None) -> None:
        body = b"" if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        if body:
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _read_json(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
        except ValueError:
            raise ServiceError(400, "invalid Content-Length")
        if length < 0 or length > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES:
            raise ServiceError(400, "request body too large")
        raw = self.rfile.read(length)
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            raise ServiceError(400, "request body must be valid JSON")
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ServiceError(400, "request body must be a JSON object")
        return data

    def _dispatch(self, method: str) -> None:
        try:
            self._route(method)
        except ServiceError as exc:
            self._send(exc.status, {"error": exc.message})
        except Exception:
            self._send(500, {"error": "internal server error"})

    def _route(self, method: str) -> None:
        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
        svc = self.server.service
        if path == "/api/health" and method == "GET":
            return self._send(200, {"status": "ok"})
        if path == "/api/notes":
            if method == "GET":
                return self._send(200, svc.list())
            if method == "POST":
                return self._send(201, svc.create(self._read_json()))
        match = _NOTE_PATH.match(path)
        if match:
            note_id = int(match.group(1))
            if method == "GET":
                return self._send(200, svc.get(note_id))
            if method == "PATCH":
                return self._send(200, svc.update(note_id, self._read_json()))
            if method == "DELETE":
                svc.delete(note_id)
                return self._send(204)
        raise ServiceError(404, "not found")

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("GET")

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("POST")

    def do_PATCH(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("PATCH")

    def do_DELETE(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("DELETE")


class NotesServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, address: tuple[str, int], service: NotesService) -> None:
        super().__init__(address, NotesHandler)
        self.service = service


def make_server(db_path: str, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 0) -> NotesServer:
    return NotesServer((host, port), NotesService(NotesRepo(db_path)))

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os

from .server import make_server


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="notes_api")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080)
    parser.add_argument("--db", default=os.environ.get("NOTES_API_DB", "notes.db"))

    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()

    main()

from typing import Any

        self.send_response(status)

        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))

        self.wfile.write(body)

# Decision matrix: Notes API

Scores 1-5 (5 best). Weighted score = score x weight. Maximum 50.

| Criterion (weight) | A layered SQLite | B single-file JSON | C pure core + event log |
|---|---|---|---|
| Simplicity (x2) | 3 -> 6 | 5 -> 10 | 2 -> 4 |
| Testability (x3) | 4 -> 12 | 4 -> 12 | 5 -> 15 |
| Security (x2) | 5 -> 10 | 3 -> 6 | 3 -> 6 |
| Scalability (x1) | 4 -> 4 | 1 -> 1 | 3 -> 3 |
| Maintenance (x2) | 4 -> 8 | 3 -> 6 | 3 -> 6 |
| **Total** | **40** | **35** | **34** |

## Notes
- **Simplicity:** B is one file; A has three small layers; C adds a log, replay and an adapter.
- **Testability:** C's pure core is the easiest to test exhaustively; A and B are both testable over real HTTP.
- **Security:** A uses parameterized SQL and transactional writes. B and C hand-roll storage and parsing; C's log cannot redact content.
- **Scalability:** SQLite handles concurrent readers and serialized writers; B rewrites the whole file per request.
- **Maintenance:** A uses a standard storage engine with clear layer boundaries.

## Recommendation
**Option A.** No hybrid: C's pure-core benefit is mostly covered by A's service layer, and the event log has no requirement behind it. Approved by the engineer of record.

+"""SQL-only persistence for notes. Every statement is parameterized."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlite3
+from contextlib import closing
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any
+
+_SCHEMA = """
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
+    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
+    title TEXT NOT NULL,
+    body TEXT NOT NULL,
+    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
+    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
+)
+"""
+
+
+def _now() -> str:
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="microseconds")
+
+
+class _Tx:
+    """Short-lived connection: commit on success, roll back on error, always close."""
+
+    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
+        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=10)
+        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+
+    def __enter__(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+        return self.conn
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
+        with closing(self.conn):
+            if exc_type is None:
+                self.conn.commit()
+            else:
+                self.conn.rollback()
+
+
+class NotesRepo:
+    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
+        self.db_path = db_path
+        with _Tx(db_path) as conn:
+            conn.execute(_SCHEMA)
+
+    def create(self, title: str, body: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        now = _now()
+        with _Tx(self.db_path) as conn:
+            cur = conn.execute(
+                "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
+                (title, body, now, now),
+            )
+            return self._get(conn, cur.lastrowid)
+
+    def list(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+        with _Tx(self.db_path) as conn:
+            rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM notes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC").fetchall()
+        return [dict(r) for r in rows]
+
+    def get(self, note_id: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        with _Tx(self.db_path) as conn:
+            return self._get(conn, note_id)
+
+    def update(self, note_id: int, fields: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        with _Tx(self.db_path) as conn:
+            if self._get(conn, note_id) is None:
+                return None
+            # Column names come from this fixed whitelist, never from the request.
+            cols = [c for c in ("title", "body") if c in fields]
+            sets = ", ".join(f"{c} = ?" for c in cols + ["updated_at"])
+            conn.execute(
+                f"UPDATE notes SET {sets} WHERE id = ?",
+                [fields[c] for c in cols] + [_now(), note_id],
+            )
+            return self._get(conn, note_id)
+
+    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> bool:
+        with _Tx(self.db_path) as conn:
+            return conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)).rowcount > 0
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _get(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
+        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)).fetchone()
+        return dict(row) if row else None

+

+

+

+        self.status = status
+        self.message = message

+
+def _title(value: Any) -> str:

+        raise ServiceError(400, "title is required")

+def _body(value: Any) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ServiceError(400, "body must be a string")

+"""HTTP adapter: routing, JSON in/out, error mapping."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import re
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+from typing import Any
+
+from .repo import NotesRepo
+from .service import NotesService, ServiceError
+
+MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 1_048_576
+_NOTE_PATH = re.compile(r"^/api/notes/(\d+)$")
+
+
+class NotesHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+    server: "NotesServer"
+
+    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:  # keep output quiet
+        pass
+
+    def _send(self, status: int, payload: Any = None) -> None:
+        body = b"" if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
+        self.send_response(status)
+        if body:
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
+        self.end_headers()
+        self.wfile.write(body)
+
+    def _read_json(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        try:
+            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ServiceError(400, "invalid Content-Length")
+        if length < 0 or length > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES:
+            raise ServiceError(400, "request body too large")
+        raw = self.rfile.read(length)
+        try:
+            data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
+        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+            raise ServiceError(400, "request body must be valid JSON")
+        if not isinstance(data, dict):
+            raise ServiceError(400, "request body must be a JSON object")
+        return data
+
+    def _dispatch(self, method: str) -> None:
+        try:
+            self._route(method)
+        except ServiceError as exc:
+            self._send(exc.status, {"error": exc.message})
+        except Exception:
+            self._send(500, {"error": "internal server error"})
+
+    def _route(self, method: str) -> None:
+        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
+        svc = self.server.service
+        if path == "/api/health" and method == "GET":
+            return self._send(200, {"status": "ok"})
+        if path == "/api/notes":
+            if method == "GET":
+                return self._send(200, svc.list())
+            if method == "POST":
+                return self._send(201, svc.create(self._read_json()))
+        match = _NOTE_PATH.match(path)
+        if match:
+            note_id = int(match.group(1))
+            if method == "GET":
+                return self._send(200, svc.get(note_id))
+            if method == "PATCH":
+                return self._send(200, svc.update(note_id, self._read_json()))
+            if method == "DELETE":
+                svc.delete(note_id)
+                return self._send(204)
+        raise ServiceError(404, "not found")
+
+    def do_GET(self) -> None:
+        self._dispatch("GET")
+
+    def do_POST(self) -> None:
+        self._dispatch("POST")
+
+    def do_PATCH(self) -> None:
+        self._dispatch("PATCH")
+
+    def do_DELETE(self) -> None:
+        self._dispatch("DELETE")
+
+
+class NotesServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
+    daemon_threads = True
+
+    def __init__(self, address: tuple[str, int], service: NotesService) -> None:
+        super().__init__(address, NotesHandler)
+        self.service = service
+
+
+def make_server(db_path: str, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 0) -> NotesServer:
+    return NotesServer((host, port), NotesService(NotesRepo(db_path)))

    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
        self.db_path = db_path
        with self._tx() as conn:
            conn.execute(_SCHEMA)

    def _tx(self):
        return _Tx(self.db_path)

    def create(self, title: str, body: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        now = _now()
        with self._tx() as conn:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO notes (title, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (title, body, now, now),
            )
            return self._get(conn, cur.lastrowid)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    def list(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        with self._tx() as conn:
            rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM notes ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC").fetchall()
        return [dict(r) for r in rows]

    def get(self, note_id: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        with self._tx() as conn:
            return self._get(conn, note_id)

    def update(self, note_id: int, fields: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        with self._tx() as conn:
            if self._get(conn, note_id) is None:
                return None
            # Column names come from this fixed whitelist, never from the request.
            cols = [c for c in ("title", "body") if c in fields]
            sets = ", ".join(f"{c} = ?" for c in cols + ["updated_at"])
            conn.execute(
                f"UPDATE notes SET {sets} WHERE id = ?",
                [fields[c] for c in cols] + [_now(), note_id],
            )
            return self._get(conn, note_id)

    def delete(self, note_id: int) -> bool:
        with self._tx() as conn:
            return conn.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)).rowcount > 0

    @staticmethod
    def _get(conn: sqlite3.Connection, note_id: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)).fetchone()
        return dict(row) if row else None


class _Tx:
    """Short-lived connection with commit-on-success / rollback-on-error."""

    def __init__(self, db_path: str) -> None:
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path, timeout=10)
        self.conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

    def __enter__(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        return self.conn

    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
        with closing(self.conn):
            if exc_type is None:
                self.conn.commit()
            else:
                self.conn.rollback()

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from .repo import NotesRepo

MAX_TITLE = 120
MAX_BODY = 10_000


class ServiceError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, status: int, message: str) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status
        self.message = message


def _title(value: Any) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ServiceError(400, "title is required")
    if len(value) > MAX_TITLE:
        raise ServiceError(400, f"title must be at most {MAX_TITLE} characters")
    return value


def _body(value: Any) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ServiceError(400, "body must be a string")
    if len(value) > MAX_BODY:
        raise ServiceError(400, f"body must be at most {MAX_BODY} characters")
    return value


class NotesService:
    def __init__(self, repo: NotesRepo) -> None:
        self.repo = repo

    def create(self, data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self.repo.create(_title(data.get("title")), _body(data.get("body", "")))

    def list(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return self.repo.list()

    def get(self, note_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        note = self.repo.get(note_id)
        if note is None:
            raise ServiceError(404, "note not found")
        return note

    def update(self, note_id: int, data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        fields: dict[str, str] = {}
        if "title" in data:
            fields["title"] = _title(data["title"])
        if "body" in data:
            fields["body"] = _body(data["body"])
        if not fields:

        note = self.repo.update(note_id, fields)

"""HTTP adapter: routing, JSON in/out, error mapping."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from typing import Any

from .repo import NotesRepo
from .service import NotesService, ServiceError

MAX_REQUEST_BYTES = 1_048_576
_NOTE_PATH = re.compile(r"^/api/notes/(\d+)$")


class NotesHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server: "NotesServer"

    def log_message(self, format: str, *args: Any) -> None:  # keep output quiet
        pass

    def _send(self, status: int, payload: Any = None) -> None:
        body = b"" if payload is None else json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        if body:
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _read_json(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
        except ValueError:
            raise ServiceError(400, "invalid Content-Length")
        if length < 0 or length > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES:
            raise ServiceError(400, "request body too large")
        raw = self.rfile.read(length)
        try:
            data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            raise ServiceError(400, "request body must be valid JSON")
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise ServiceError(400, "request body must be a JSON object")
        return data

    def _dispatch(self, method: str) -> None:
        try:
            self._route(method)
        except ServiceError as exc:
            self._send(exc.status, {"error": exc.message})
        except Exception:
            self._send(500, {"error": "internal server error"})

    def _route(self, method: str) -> None:
        path = self.path.split("?", 1)[0]
        svc = self.server.service
        if path == "/api/health" and method == "GET":
            return self._send(200, {"status": "ok"})
        if path == "/api/notes":
            if method == "GET":
                return self._send(200, svc.list())
            if method == "POST":
                return self._send(201, svc.create(self._read_json()))
        match = _NOTE_PATH.match(path)
        if match:
            note_id = int(match.group(1))
            if method == "GET":
                return self._send(200, svc.get(note_id))
            if method == "PATCH":
                return self._send(200, svc.update(note_id, self._read_json()))
            if method == "DELETE":
                svc.delete(note_id)
                return self._send(204)
        raise ServiceError(404, "not found")

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("GET")

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("POST")

    def do_PATCH(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("PATCH")

    def do_DELETE(self) -> None:
        self._dispatch("DELETE")


class NotesServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True

    def __init__(self, address: tuple[str, int], service: NotesService) -> None:
        super().__init__(address, NotesHandler)
        self.service = service


def make_server(db_path: str, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 0) -> NotesServer:
    return NotesServer((host, port), NotesService(NotesRepo(db_path)))
